points: \item Implemented a self-correcting RAG system using LangChain and Mistral 7B, improving answer reliability and mitigating context errors in document-level QA for marketing and personalization systems.
\item Built a hybrid retrieval workflow combining dense embeddings and BM25 search, enhancing relevance and coverage of retrieved documents for multimodal AI and autonomous agents.
\item Developed an LLM-as-Judge evaluation pipeline to assess faithfulness and relevance across hundreds of QA examples, ensuring production-ready reliability for Adobe AI products.
\item Introduced batched query extraction, reducing LLM calls by ~80% per query and enabling faster, reliable production inference for predictive recommendation models.
\item Built end-to-end ML pipeline using MLflow, deploying production models on AWS with automated training and inference for adaptive decision-making systems.
